definitions.gloss: abandoned house; dilapidated building; ruined house
definitions.explanation: A house or building that has been abandoned and fallen into disrepair. Often used in the context of rural depopulation or horror settings.

examples.japanese: あの{廃屋|はいおく}には{誰|だれ}も{住|す}んでいない。
examples.english: Nobody lives in that abandoned house.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}のはずれに{古|ふる}い{廃屋|はいおく}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: An old abandoned house remains on the outskirts of the village.

examples.japanese: {過疎化|かそか}が{進|すす}み、{廃屋|はいおく}が{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えている{地域|ちいき}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many areas where depopulation is advancing and abandoned houses are increasing year by year.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word often seen in news articles discussing rural depopulation and urban decay. Also commonly appears in horror and mystery fiction. The issue of {廃屋|はいおく} has become a social problem in Japan due to declining population.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {廃屋|はいおく}が{増|ふ}える (abandoned houses increase)
- {廃屋|はいおく}を{解体|かいたい}する (to demolish an abandoned house)
- {廃屋|はいおく}{同然|どうぜん} (practically a ruin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空|あ}き{家|や}: vacant house — may be temporarily unoccupied but not necessarily ruined
- {廃墟|はいきょ}: ruins — broader term including any type of ruined structure
